title: ukukhangela isiqinisekiso ngokukhanya kweenkwenkwezi
intro: Khawuzibone umi phantsi kwesibhakabhaka esikhulu sasebusuku, ubukele izibane ezikhanyayo ziphuma zize ziphele ngelixa ufuna into efanele ukunqulwa ngokwenene. Kukujikelezile, imifanekiso eqingqiweyo engathethiyo ifumana indumiso neminikelo, kodwa isizathu esicacileyo siyawathandabuza amandla ayo. Ilizwi elinesibindi liza kucel’ umngeni amasiko azuzwe njengelifa kwaye likhombe kuMdali wamazulu nomhlaba.
clues: Ndajonga iinkwenkwezi, inyanga, nelanga, ndaza ndacinga ukuba azinakuba yiNkosi yam kuba ziyatshona zize zinyamalale.
Ndayikhanyela ngokuphandle into eyayinqulwa ngabantu bam ngaphandle kuka-Allah, ndababiza ukuba banqule uMdali yedwa.
Ndixoxe ngomlawuli ozidlayo owathi unika ubomi nokufa, ndaza ndaphendula ngokukhankanya uAllah ozisa ilanga livela empuma.
Ndazibetha izithixo ndaza ndaziqhekeza, ndashiya kuphela ezona zinkulu phakathi kwazo ukuze abantu babuyele kuzo.
Ndabanjwa ndaza ndagwetywa ngabantu bakowethu, abathi makhe isakhiwo ndiphoswe emlilweni ovuthayo.
Ndasindiswa xa uAllah wayalela umlilo ukuba ube yindawo epholileyo nekhuselekileyo kum.
